assessments.real_politics: Full authoritarian state. All opposition eliminated — Navalny died in prison. Elections are theater. Media is state propaganda. Criticizing the war is criminal. Regime stable through fear and nationalism.

assessments.name: Egypt
assessments.real_politics: Military dictatorship with civilian facade. Sisi eliminated all opposition — 60,000+ political prisoners. Military-owned enterprises crowd out private sector.

assessments.name: Iran
assessments.real_politics: Theocratic dictatorship with managed electoral facade. IRGC runs parallel economy and military. Supreme Leader succession is the central hidden anxiety. Population broadly hostile to system but fragmented.

assessments.name: Pakistan
assessments.real_politics: Military is the permanent government — civilians serve at generals' pleasure. Imran Khan imprisoned. ISI operates as state within state. Democracy is theater directed by GHQ.

assessments.name: Thailand
assessments.real_politics: Military is the real power — coups are the succession mechanism. Lese-majeste law makes discussing monarchy impossible. Democracy is performative when generals approve.

assessments.name: Turkey
assessments.real_politics: Erdogan transformed parliamentary democracy into presidential autocracy. Media captured, judiciary subservient. Patronage networks and religious identity keep base loyal despite economic mismanagement.

assessments.name: Nigeria
assessments.real_politics: Democracy captured by small elite rotating power. Large portions ungovernable. Oil revenue looted for decades. Election fraud standard practice.

assessments.name: Mexico
assessments.real_politics: Cartels are the real governing power in large parts of the country. Most dangerous country for journalists. Judiciary restructured to serve ruling party. Corruption endemic.

assessments.name: India
assessments.real_politics: BJP has systematically weakened democratic institutions while maintaining democratic form. Media largely captured — critical journalists face raids and charges. Muslim minority increasingly marginalized. Becoming electoral autocracy.

assessments.name: Ukraine
assessments.real_politics: Wartime democracy — Zelenskyy centralized power from necessity but democratic culture survives. Pre-war oligarch capture destroyed by war. EU accession reforms real. Reconstruction will be biggest corruption test.

assessments.name: Israel
assessments.real_politics: Democracy for Jewish citizens, military occupation for Palestinians. Netanyahu faces corruption charges while governing with ultranationalist coalition. Settler movement operates above the law. Judiciary under assault.

assessments.name: Brazil

assessments.name: United States

assessments.name: France
assessments.real_politics: Macron governs without mandate — parliament ungovernable. Deep disconnect between Paris elite and the rest of France. Le Pen's RN is the real opposition.

assessments.name: United Kingdom
assessments.real_politics: Real power sits with City of London and media barons. Labour won by default against collapsed Conservatives. NHS quietly privatized through underfunding. Among most extensive surveillance states in democracies.

assessments.name: Japan
assessments.real_politics: One-party democracy — LDP ruled almost continuously since 1955. Bureaucracy runs the country regardless of PM. Media self-censors on imperial family and organized crime's political ties.

assessments.name: Germany
